candidates.change_summary: Change the return value from true to false when the loop completes without revert.
Change the loop condition to require _tos.length >= 0 (always true) instead of > 0, which allows empty array and reverts with array index error.
Change the loop condition from i < _tos.length to i <= _tos.length to cause out-of-bounds array access on the last iteration.
Change the selector to transferFrom(address,address,uint) (missing one uint parameter type) to compute a different function selector, altering the called function signature.
Change require(_s) to require(!_s), reverting on successful call instead of failed call.
Delete the require statement for _tos.length, allowing the loop to run with zero-length array (skipping loop) without reverting.
